labels.label: Thriller
labels.rule: 4.5 stars or more, margin of 1 or less, 3 or more goals

labels.label: Late Drama
labels.rule: result-changing goal at 88' or later (stoppage included) or in extra time; second legs also on the aggregate

labels.label: Comeback
labels.rule: winner trailed at or after 60', or a team came back from 2 down to avoid defeat; second legs also on the aggregate

labels.label: Upset
labels.rule: domestic only: winner's de-vigged closing probability of 25% or less

labels.label: Hidden Gem
labels.rule: 4 stars or more with 2 goals or fewer

labels.label: Chaos
labels.rule: 4 or more of: red cards, penalties awarded, equalisers, lead changes

uefa_source.attribution: ESPN public match data (scores, events, shots on target, cards); no xG available

feature.head: Six goals, three in stoppage time, and nobody won.
feature.dek: Sevilla were 2–0 up after 54′. Levante equalised at 90+10′.
